traceability.notes: docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md specifies format and syntax validation for @story and @req, including multi-line handling, flexible parsing, specific error messages, and path/identifier patterns. The implementation is provided by the traceability/valid-annotation-format rule and its helpers in src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts, src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-validators.ts, and src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-utils.ts. These modules: (1) validate @story paths against a regex and apply safe suffix-only fixes while rejecting traversal (REQ-PATH-FORMAT, REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT); (2) validate @req identifiers against a regex, distinguishing missing vs invalid values (REQ-REQ-FORMAT, REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION); (3) collapse multi-line annotation values into single logical values and process JSDoc-style formatting and whitespace (REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT, REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING); and (4) centralize clear, specific error messages that embed the offending value and an example (REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION, REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY). The rule is registered in the plugin’s RULE_NAMES and included in recommended/strict configs, satisfying ESLint best-practices and integration with the rest of the plugin. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts explicitly cover each requirement ID for this story and assert both behavior and error message text, while tests/perf/valid-annotation-format-large-file.test.ts verify performance and multi-line/whitespace behavior at scale. All these tests are currently passing under Jest. Based on this concrete code and test evidence, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are fully implemented.
